question: Is the Lord's descent of power caused by any motive?
premises: If the Lord acted from a motive, he would selectively direct his power in a restricted way.
The Lord has no attachment or aversion that could supply such a motive.
Therefore the descent of the great Lord's power is without motive.
inference: The descent of power is not motivated by passion but occurs without external cause in the Lord.
plain_english: There is no motive by which the all-pervading Lord would cause his own power to descend in a restricted way anywhere; thus this descent of the great Lord's power is without motive.
